panels.title: Stage
panels.description: Boot stage and whether the machine reached ready. No data means the Talos API is unreachable.

targets.expr: max by (stage) (max by (node) (talos_machine_ready{node="$node"}) * on (node) group_left (stage) max by (node, stage) (talos_machine_stage_info{node="$node"}))

panels.title: Services
panels.description: Healthy services out of all services on the node.

targets.expr: count(max by (service) (((talos_service_running == 1) and (talos_service_healthy == 1) and (talos_service_health_unknown == 0)))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Not healthy
panels.description: Stopped, or running and failing a check they publish. No-check services are excluded.

targets.expr: count(max by (service) ((talos_service_running == 0)) or max by (service) (((talos_service_running == 1) and (talos_service_healthy == 0) and (talos_service_health_unknown == 0)))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Diagnostics
panels.description: Warnings Talos raised about this node. Zero-initialised, so 0 means checked and clean.

panels.title: Load · 1m
panels.description: Run-queue length. Read it against the node's thread count, not against 1.0.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since boot. A sawtooth drop in the sparkline is a reboot inside the window.

panels.title: Changed in window
panels.description: Every way this node's state could have moved inside the window. All zeros means it was quiet.

targets.expr:
label_replace(max(changes(talos_time_epoch{node="$node"}[$__range])), "event", "Clock steps", "", "")
  or
label_replace(max(changes(talos_time_synced{node="$node"}[$__range])), "event", "Clock sync flips", "", "")
  or
label_replace(max(changes(talos_diagnostics{node="$node"}[$__range])), "event", "Diagnostics changed", "", "")
  or
label_replace(max(changes(talos_machine_ready{node="$node"}[$__range])), "event", "Machine ready flips", "", "")
  or
label_replace(max(resets(talos_node_uptime_seconds{node="$node"}[$__range])), "event", "Reboots", "", "")
  or
label_replace(sum(max by (service) (changes(talos_service_running{node="$node"}[$__range]) + changes(talos_service_healthy{node="$node"}[$__range]) + changes(talos_service_health_unknown{node="$node"}[$__range]))), "event", "Service state changes", "", "")

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: The three kernel windows. 1m above 15m is load arriving; the reverse is load draining.

panels.title: Processes
panels.description: Runnable against uninterruptible-sleep. Blocked processes inflate load without using CPU.

panels.title: Services not healthy
panels.description: Flat on the floor while the node is fine. The dashed line marks 1.

targets.expr: count(max by (service) ((talos_service_running == 0)) or max by (service) (((talos_service_running == 1) and (talos_service_healthy == 0) and (talos_service_health_unknown == 0)))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Clock offset & error
panels.description: Offset, the bounds ntpd puts around it, and oscillator drift on its own axis.

panels.title: Failing
panels.description: Running, but failing a health check it publishes.

targets.expr: count(max by (service) (((talos_service_running == 1) and (talos_service_healthy == 0) and (talos_service_health_unknown == 0)))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Stopped
panels.description: Services that are not running at all.

panels.title: No health check
panels.description: Running but never verified. Not a fault: health checks are opt-in.

panels.title: Unmet conditions
panels.description: Conditions still blocking the machine from reaching ready. Always 0 once ready.

panels.title: Machine
panels.description: DMI identity, processor, address and versions. Firmware placeholders are shown raw.

targets.expr:
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, manufacturer) (talos_hw_system_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 1, "property", "Manufacturer", "", ""), "value", "$1", "manufacturer", "(.*)"), "manufacturer", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, product) (talos_hw_system_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 2, "property", "Product", "", ""), "value", "$1", "product", "(.*)"), "product", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, version) (talos_hw_system_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 3, "property", "Product version", "", ""), "value", "$1", "version", "(.*)"), "version", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, serial_number) (talos_hw_system_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 4, "property", "Serial number", "", ""), "value", "$1", "serial_number", "(.*)"), "serial_number", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, uuid) (talos_hw_system_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 5, "property", "UUID", "", ""), "value", "$1", "uuid", "(.*)"), "uuid", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, product) (talos_hw_processor_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 6, "property", "CPU", "", ""), "value", "$1", "product", "(.*)"), "product", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, socket) (talos_hw_processor_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 7, "property", "CPU socket", "", ""), "value", "$1", "socket", "(.*)"), "socket", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, ip) (talos_node_k8s_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 8, "property", "IP address", "", ""), "value", "$1", "ip", "(.*)"), "ip", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, hostname) (talos_node_k8s_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 9, "property", "Hostname", "", ""), "value", "$1", "hostname", "(.*)"), "hostname", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, os) (talos_node_k8s_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 10, "property", "OS", "", ""), "value", "$1", "os", "(.*)"), "os", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, arch) (talos_node_version_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 11, "property", "Architecture", "", ""), "value", "$1", "arch", "(.*)"), "arch", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, version) (talos_node_version_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 12, "property", "Talos version", "", ""), "value", "$1", "version", "(.*)"), "version", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, sha) (talos_node_version_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 13, "property", "Talos build", "", ""), "value", "$1", "sha", "(.*)"), "sha", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, kube_version) (talos_node_k8s_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 14, "property", "Kubernetes version", "", ""), "value", "$1", "kube_version", "(.*)"), "kube_version", "", "", "")

panels.title: Services
panels.description: Every service, the state it is in, and how many times that state moved inside the window.

targets.expr:
label_replace(max by (service) (((talos_service_running == 1) and (talos_service_healthy == 1) and (talos_service_health_unknown == 0))), "state", "healthy", "", "")
  or
label_replace(max by (service) (((talos_service_running == 1) and (talos_service_health_unknown == 1))), "state", "no check", "", "")
  or
label_replace(max by (service) (((talos_service_running == 1) and (talos_service_healthy == 0) and (talos_service_health_unknown == 0))), "state", "failing", "", "")
  or
label_replace(max by (service) ((talos_service_running == 0)), "state", "stopped", "", "")

panels.title: Clock
panels.description: Current clock readings. ntpd's verdict and the kernel's STA_UNSYNC flag are different facts.

panels.title: Diagnostics
panels.description: Warnings Talos raised, linked to the upstream reference.

panels.title: Unmet conditions
panels.description: What is still blocking ready, and why. Absent on a ready node.

panels.title: Schematic
panels.description: The Image Factory id, trimmed to 12 characters.

panels.title: Extensions
panels.description: System extensions in the image. The virtual `schematic` and `modules.dep` entries are excluded.

panels.title: Booted entry
panels.description: The A/B boot slot the node actually came up on.

panels.title: Secure boot
panels.description: UEFI Secure Boot state; the rest of the posture is in the table below.

panels.title: Image & boot
panels.description: What is running, and how many distinct values each had in the window. All 1 means nothing changed.

targets.expr:
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, version) (talos_node_version_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 1, "property", "Talos version", "", ""), "value", "$1", "version", "(.*)"), "version", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, version) (talos_extension_info{node="$node", extension="modules.dep"}) * 0 + 2, "property", "Kernel", "", ""), "value", "$1", "version", "(.*)"), "version", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, entry) (talos_booted_entry_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 3, "property", "Boot entry", "", ""), "value", "$1", "entry", "(.*)"), "entry", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, schematic) (talos_schematic_info{node="$node"}) * 0 + 4, "property", "Image Factory schematic", "", ""), "value", "$1", "schematic", "(.*)"), "schematic", "", "", "")

label_replace(count(count by (version) (last_over_time(talos_node_version_info{node="$node"}[$__range]))), "property", "Talos version", "", "")
  or
label_replace(count(count by (version) (last_over_time(talos_extension_info{node="$node", extension="modules.dep"}[$__range]))), "property", "Kernel", "", "")
  or
label_replace(count(count by (entry) (last_over_time(talos_booted_entry_info{node="$node"}[$__range]))), "property", "Boot entry", "", "")
  or
label_replace(count(count by (schematic) (last_over_time(talos_schematic_info{node="$node"}[$__range]))), "property", "Image Factory schematic", "", "")

panels.title: Security posture
panels.description: SELinux and FIPS carry a state string because Talos reports more than two states for each.

panels.title: System extensions
panels.description: What is installed on top of the base image.

panels.title: Kernel
panels.description: The running kernel, from the version of the `modules.dep` extension.

panels.title: Tunables
panels.description: Sysctls Talos manages, and how many differ from the value the kernel carried before Talos wrote.

panels.title: Unsupported
panels.description: Parameters the running kernel does not recognise, so the configured value is silently ignored.

panels.title: Modules
panels.description: Kernel modules currently loaded.

panels.title: Kernel command line
panels.description: What the node booted with. A machineconfig argument that never took effect is visible only here.

panels.title: Kernel parameters (sysctl)
panels.description: Sysctls Talos manages. Default is the value before Talos wrote it; Unsupported means the kernel ignores it.

panels.title: Loaded modules
panels.description: Loaded modules with their memory footprint and reference count.
